exposure: encouragement to breastfeed by medical staff
cohort: The study included 874 Romanian mothers who responded to an online survey distributed via social media platforms.
finding: Despite high breastfeeding intention (87.2%), exclusive breastfeeding rates were suboptimal (56.1%) among Romanian mothers, with maternal age >= 30, Cesarean delivery, absence of rooming-in, and pacifier use significantly associated with reduced likelihood of exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with a reduced likelihood of exclusive breastfeeding (OR = 1.78, p < 0.001).
